symptomReferences.parent: Am-c, aml-n., Ars., asaf., broni., bry., calc.,

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Bloated, disturbing sleep. Infantile colic.
Bilious colic with great accumulation of gas.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Voice husky. Tip of nose sore to
touch. Throat dry and sore, as if pin crosswise in it.
Dry cough, worse from air into larynx, tobacco smoke
(Merc.), talking; with irritation in suprasternal fossa
[Rumex ] Trachea painful to touch.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Every scratch becomes a sore. Itching of
arm and hand when writing. Vaginal pruritus. Herpes
zoster. [Ars.; Ran. bulb.]

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Rumex: Laches.: Mentha
pulegium (pain in bones of forehead And extremities).
